description: Returns recent ERC-20 Transfer events involving an address by scanning the last N blocks via RPC. For a complete view including native transfers and contract calls, use the explorer URL in the response.

address.description: Address or '.nad' name to query. Defaults to the authenticated user's wallet.

lookback_blocks.description: Number of blocks back from head to scan for ERC-20 Transfer events involving this address. Scanned in 100-block windows (Monad RPC caps eth_getLogs at 100 blocks). Capped at 50k.

network.description: Monad network — "mainnet" or "testnet". Defaults to the server's configured network.

name: get_transaction_history
title: Get recent transaction history
